MAR — Marine Excursion

Safari Blue / Menai Bay dhow day

7–9 hours · Fumba → Menai Bay → Kwale Island

From $45–$160 per person
Book via WhatsApp

Overview

Zanzibar's most famous dhow excursion: cruise to the Menai Bay Conservation Area, snorkel over vibrant coral reefs, feast on a seafood barbecue on a private sandbank, and visit Kwale Island. Operated by the original Safari Blue since 1990.

What to Expect

  • Full-day dhow sailing trip (7–9 hours)
  • Snorkeling over coral reefs with mask, snorkel, and life jacket provided
  • Seafood barbecue lunch (grilled fish, prawns, calamari) on a sandbank
  • Fresh fruit, water, and soft drinks throughout
  • Menai Bay conservation fee included in package price
  • Visit to Kwale Island for swimming

Duration & Meeting Point

Duration: 7–9 hours (full day)

Meeting point: Fumba Peninsula — pickup from Stone Town hotels available

Important Notes

  • Marine conservation fee: $10 for non-EAC adults (included in our price)
  • Bring a towel, hat, sunscreen (reef-safe), and swimwear
  • Limited daily capacity — booking essential
  • Copycat products and overcrowding are key risks — we only recommend the licensed original Safari Blue

Inclusions

  • Dhow, snorkeling, sandbank, seafood lunch, drinks, guide
